subject: general
question: In which river has the National Waterways-2 (NW-2) been developed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Brahmaputra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterway-2 (NW-2)** has been developed on the Brahmaputra River.
 
• NW-2 extends from **Dhubri to Sadiya** in Assam, covering a distance of approximately 891 km.
 
• This waterway is significant for **transportation and trade** in the northeastern region of India.
 
• It promotes the use of **inland water transport** for cargo movement, reducing congestion on roadways.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 2
 The Krishna River is not designated as a national waterway.
 
 

 Option 3
 The Ganga River is designated as National Waterway-1 (NW-1).
 
 

 Option 4
 The Narmada River is not designated as a national waterway.
